text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By now, Eishin Flash has a number of
victories
under her belt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm sorting through her race history, I
realize
something...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So, I take her to the Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not only has she won many high-level
G1 races,
she's really made a name for
herself here at the
Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Despite remembering every race I've
run, I didn't
realize I had achieved so
much at the Tokyo
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My most recent memory is... the autumn
Tenno
Sho from my senior year.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I was able to win a race that my parents
were
present to watch.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You were watching me as well. I could
tell how
happy you were that day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That alone triggered so many memories
we
shared... Thanking you came so
naturally that
day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I shall remember that moment for as long
as I live.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That's how strong an impression it left on
me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you ever so much. I'm touched.
